  "title": "Remove Google Analytics and any other trackers from crates.io website",
  "body": "Currently https://crates.io/ has this:\n\n``` html\n<script>\n      (function(i,s,o,g,r,a,m){i['GoogleAnalyticsObject']=r;i[r]=i[r]||function(){\n      (i[r].q=i[r].q||[]).push(arguments)},i[r].l=1*new Date();a=s.createElement(o),\n      m=s.getElementsByTagName(o)[0];a.async=1;a.src=g;m.parentNode.insertBefore(a,m)\n      })(window,document,'script','//www.google-analytics.com/analytics.js','ga');\n\n      ga('create', 'UA-58390457-3', 'auto');\n      ga('send', 'pageview');\n    </script>\n```\n\nPlease remove this and other third-party tracking mechanisms, if any, from the crates.io website.\n\nLots of people working on Rust crates are privacy advocates like myself, trying to build privacy and/or anti-tracking tools. crates.io is basically a mandatory part of publishing Rust crates, because the design of the Rust ecosystem basically forces us to use it. This creates a conflict if crates.io itself uses the tracking mechanisms that we're working to protect people from.\n",
  "author": "Participant 1",

    {
      "id": 255440538,
      "url": "https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io/issues/460#issuecomment-255440538",
      "created_at": "2016-10-21T18:48:03Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Maybe some anti-tracking plugins in browser will be more effective for you?\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 296977899,
      "url": "https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io/issues/460#issuecomment-296977899",
      "created_at": "2017-04-25T09:46:37Z",
      "updated_at": "2017-04-25T09:47:40Z",
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "I second the request. Anti-tracking plugins are only effective for people already aware of the issue.\r\n\r\nThe issue is even bigger now, as badges usually have trackers.\r\n\r\nIt's frankly surprising to see Mozilla being so supportive of the project when they advocate for a web free of these problems."
    },
    {
      "id": 297025855,
      "url": "https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io/issues/460#issuecomment-297025855",
      "created_at": "2017-04-25T13:14:55Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "I'd love PRs to add proxying of badges through the backend."
    },
    {
      "id": 299644282,
      "url": "https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io/issues/460#issuecomment-299644282",
      "created_at": "2017-05-06T14:43:27Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "The core team discussed this- we occasionally use Google Analytics to inform decisions ([example](https://github.com/integer32llc/rfcs/blob/tiered-browser-support/text/0000-tiered-browser-support.md#google-analytics-browser-usage-stats)), and this is the easiest solution for us for now. We haven't researched self-hosted analytics gathering tools, so if someone would do that research and make some recommendations and PRs to add such a tool so that we could continue to get the data we need without going through a third party, we'd be open to that. \r\n\r\nAlso, users have the workaround available of blocking third-party requests via browser extensions.\r\n\r\nSo I'm going to leave this open with a \"help wanted\" label for now, but it won't be a high priority unless we get that help."
    }
  ],
